contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
IMP C CARAVSIVS P F [AVG] ; R/ VIR[TVS AVG]

A copper alloy radiate of Carausius dating to the period AD 286 - 293 (Reece Period 14), VIR[TVS AVG] reverse type depicting Mars standing left leaning on shield and holding spear. Unattributed mint or Rouen. It is not possible to confirm the inscription IMP C CARAVSIVS P F [AVG] from the image. This legend is unrecorded in RIC for unattributed coins (RIC V, pt 2, p. 545, cf 1047), but is known for Rouen (RIC V, pt 2, p. 523, cf 700, and examples in Sam Moorhead's corpus). Coin to be compared with other coins in corpus. This coin has been included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
